answer: A network could require Licensed notary public record with notarial society attestation before the first reward. Since acts the society recorded across years of notarisations, the ocean is that fakes arrive expensive and honest agents arrive free. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the haven is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the oasis is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
